_comment: Installer-size budget gate (product bar #66 lane 5, issue #72). baseline_display is what the v0.1.1 release page shows (github.com/kahlanhamza/IUM/releases/tag/v0.1.1, measured 2026-11-06); baseline_bytes is that display value in bytes (MB = 1024*1024), kept for the headroom column. max_bytes is the ship ceiling: exceeding it FAILS the release job. Growth is a reviewed diff to this table, never a silent ship.
